title: Popliteus Assessment
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: With the patient supine or prone, flex both knees to thirty degrees, rotate both feet externally together and compare the thigh foot angles.
Repeat at ninety degrees of flexion, because the difference between the two angles is what separates the corner from the posterior cruciate.
An increase at both thirty and ninety degrees indicates the corner and the posterior cruciate together.
